title: Sessions swap themselves out: when a session's work is done, the agent saves everything to tasks and goals, then with the user's OK closes itself and opens a fresh session on the next goal
user_said: the agent should constantly be trying to accomplish goals and tasks, and when done its workload, its heavily incentivized to ask the user to close the session and start a new fresh one to save tokens/context, and the agent can do that (it can do it for the user). this constant swap out is an optimization feature. but it DEPENDS fully on making sure all details are saved into tasks/goals
